- `cli-e2e-tests` is `crate-rca`'s `tests/e2e`: 62 tests in 2227 s that drive the real opencode with a live model (parity_features: each test 14 to 90 s). It reran because the library migration changed `clis/Cargo.lock`, an input of every clis crate's tasks: this was the first run since then that got past the deploy legs (`cargo tree` shows `offload` does not depend on `blob-cache`). One test, `a_subagent_is_called_through_the_task_tool_with_its_own_session_and_its_own_rules_on_both`, failed because the model did not say the word the test waits for: a live-model assertion, not a code failure.
